decks.notes: The key concept of this deck is to use Kenrith, the Returned King as the commander to enable a powerful combo strategy. The deck includes a variety of cards that focus on graveyard recursion, such as Animate Dead, Exhume, and Reanimate, to bring back key creatures like Griselbrand and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse. It also includes cards like Buried Alive and Unmarked Grave to quickly fill the graveyard. The deck also has control elements with cards like Thoughtseize, Duress, and Swords to Plowshares to disrupt opponents' strategies. Additionally, the deck has several ways to generate extra mana with cards like Solitude, Talismans, and Lotus Petal. The deck ultimately aims to assemble the Worldgorger Dragon combo, either by using flicker effects or reanimation spells, to generate infinite mana and win the game.

This deck focuses on fast-paced, aggressive gameplay utilizing the partnership of Bruse Tarl and Yoshimaru as commanders. With a mix of efficient creatures, removal spells, and equipment like Embercleave and Umezawa's Jitte, the deck aims to apply constant pressure on the opponent and overwhelm them quickly. The inclusion of cards like Giver of Runes and Mother of Runes help protect key creatures, while cards like Blood Moon and Magus of the Moon disrupt opponents' mana bases. The deck also includes powerful cards like Palace Jailer and Skyclave Apparition for removal and disruption, allowing the aggressive strategy to push through defenses and secure victories efficiently.

The deck revolves around utilizing Tivit, Seller of Secrets as a control commander to manipulate and disrupt the opponent's game plan. It includes a wide range of counterspells and removal spells to keep the opponent in check, while also using card draw and selection spells like Brainstorm, Fact or Fiction, and Preordain to maintain card advantage. The deck also includes powerful planeswalkers like Jace, the Mind Sculptor and Teferi, Time Raveler to further control the game. Finally, it includes a variety of lands to ensure consistent mana production and access to different colors of mana. Overall, the deck aims to control the game, disrupt the opponent's strategy, and eventually win through incremental advantage.

This aggressive deck utilizes the partner commanders Kraum and Yoshimaru to overwhelm opponents with a combination of fast, efficient creatures and powerful spells. The deck focuses on controlling the board with removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Lightning Bolt while deploying threats like Adeline, Resplendent Cathar and Boromir to apply pressure. The deck also includes powerful equipment like Embercleave and Umezawa's Jitte to enhance its creatures and push through damage. With a mix of efficient creatures, removal spells, and powerful equipment, this deck aims to consistently apply pressure and disrupt opponents' strategies to secure victory in fast-paced one-on-one matches.

The deck focuses on utilizing Atraxa's abilities to control the game, maintaining board presence, and disrupting opponent's strategy effectively. With a mix of control spells, removals, counterspells, and versatile planeswalkers, the deck aims to dictate the pace of the game and outvalue the opponent. The mana base is carefully crafted to provide consistency and flexibility, enabling the deck to cast a variety of powerful spells efficiently. The inclusion of cards like Emrakul, the Promised End and Atraxa, Praetors' Voice adds a potent threat and synergy to the overall strategy. By leveraging Atraxa's abilities and powerful cards, the deck aims to outmaneuver opponents and emerge victorious in the 1 vs 1 format.

This deck focuses on utilizing Grist, the Hunger Tide as the commander to establish a fast and aggressive playstyle. The deck includes a variety of mana dorks to ramp up quickly, along with removal spells like Abrupt Decay and Dismember to control the board. Key cards like Fauna Shaman and Green Sun's Zenith allow for tutoring and consistency in finding important creatures. The deck also includes graveyard recursion with cards like Reanimate and Recurring Nightmare, enabling powerful plays with creatures like Sheoldred. The overall strategy is to swarm the board with efficient creatures, disrupt the opponent's game plan with removal and hand disruption, and close out the game quickly with high-powered threats like Tarmogoyf and Questing Beast.

This deck focuses on building a strong board presence quickly and efficiently through a combination of aggressive creatures and disruptive spells. Raffine, Scheming Seer serves as the commander, providing card advantage and versatility to help maintain tempo. The deck includes a mix of low-cost creatures like Faerie Seer and Thraben Inspector to apply early pressure, as well as powerful disruption spells like Counterspell and Fatal Push to control the board. By utilizing a variety of aggressive threats and interactive spells, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a combination of speed and disruption, ensuring that it can maintain control of the game and secure a victory.

The key concept of this deck is to establish control over the game by utilizing various removal spells and abilities to eliminate threats.
